description:
Kesh will see you now.

It is a consultation, and it's genuinely one. She'll talk you out of two of the three things you might have wanted, on the grounds that they aren't worth what they cost you. She's a good surgeon and she isn't selling.

What she doesn't say, because it's on the form and she assumes you have read the form, is that this is the last appointment at which you're a person who has never been opened. The Exodus can undo it, at a price, and nobody else in this city can, and Kesh doesn't do that work and won't say who does.

"Sit down," she says. "Nothing today. Today we talk about it, and you go home, and you think about whether you want it. Come back when you know."
name: The Account

emotes: {who} is talked out of the expensive one, at length, by the woman who would have been paid for it.
{who} is asked what they do with their hands all day, and answers, and watches her write it down.
{who} signs the form on the second page and isn't asked to read the first.
